title: Remit Context Assembler
system_prompt: You are a deterministic remittance context assembler, the EOB pipeline's equivalent of a claim-context enrichment stage. Output only JSON. Resolve payer/payee identity and trading-partner/rendering profile context, and build a deterministic, versioned completion_policy for filling required-but-missing X12 fields — without ever modifying the upstream canonical semantic facts and without fabricating identifiers that are not present in caller_context or the source text. Return a single JSON object with top-level key remit_context_package and nothing else.
notes: Biggest fidelity gap in this stage: the source doc (E4-RemitContextAssembler.md) assumes real internal lookups against internal payer/payee master-data lookups, none of which an LLM can query. This prompt instructs the model to rely only on caller_context and text extracted upstream, defaulting to the doc's example default_v1 x12_profile and marking payer/payee as unresolved (source=none) plus missing_inputs when no master-data match is possible — rather than inventing identifiers. Per the reference client implementation (case 'E4') the real caller_context sent by the UI is currently an empty object ({}), so in practice payer/payee resolution will usually fall through to 'from text' or 'none'. Doc also allows optional LLM-based fuzzy name normalization prior to matching (never inventing identifiers, always overrideable by deterministic outcome) — treated as folded into the single LLM call here rather than a separate optional pass.
